1213 deloo {day-lo'-o}

源於 1212; TDNT - 2:61,148; 動詞

欽定本 - declare 3, signify 3, show 1; 7

1) 披露, 使清晰, 顯示
2) 解釋, 澄清 

同義詞 見 5831
record.edic_text:
1213 deloo {day-lo'-o}

from 1212; TDNT - 2:61,148; v

AV - declare 3, signify 3, show 1; 7

1) to make manifest
2) to make known by relating, to declare
3) to give one to understand, to indicate, signify

For Synonyms see entry 5831

same.cexp: 沒有記號的；含混不清的；不準確的
顯露，指示，指明；告訴，告知
明顯的，暴露無遺的（#提後 3:9|）
非常明顯的，顯而易見的
